lucy_am: FYI — NovaraHealth (acct NH-77) opened a dispute on INV-2026-04; they say the reserved commit proration during their model migration double-billed a partial commit for the migration window. Posting invoice snippet and timeline.

lucy_am: Invoice lines (excerpt):
```
INV-2026-04 | NH-77 | Reserved Commit (monthly) | $9,000.00
INV-2026-04 | NH-77-migration | Reserved Commit Prorated (04/05 11:45-12:30) | $1,250.00  <-- unexpected
INV-2026-04 | NH-77 | Burst (04/05 12:05-12:20) | $420.00
```

lucy_am: Customer says they were migrating inside their reserved commit window and shouldn't see an extra prorated reserved line. They flagged it as double-billing. Can ops confirm?

noah_ops: Checking allocator and migration logs. Ran `alloc-query --acct NH-77 --window 2026-04-05T11:30-12:45`. Findings: migration orchestration created a temporary tag `nh:mig-20260405` and at the same time the commit allocator ran a proration job that treats new tags as separate buckets. Migration service created the temp tag at 11:46, migration traffic shifted at 12:05, and the proration job executed 12:10 which recorded a small prorated commit against the migration tag instead of attributing to the parent account.

noah_ops: TL;DR: tokens consumed during migration were within the committed pool but a proration race assigned a separate proration charge to the migration tag. We have metering that shows total tokens are within the reserved commit limit. No extra token consumption.

lucy_am: OK. What's the correct remedy? Customer requests corrected invoice and an explanation.

devin_billing: Proposed remediation:
- Remove prorated reserved line $1,250 (refund/credit).
- Apply goodwill SLA concession: 2% of monthly committed ($9,000) = $180 because migration caused a 12m elevated latency window (their contract SLA is 3% per incident, capped at 9%, but we usually grant 2% for migration disruptions).
- Waive small burst fee $420 as courtesy.

lucy_am: Proposed total credit = $1,250 + $180 + $420 = $1,850. Suggest we offer a one-time fix and include a short RCA.

raj_fin: I can approve up to $2,000 provisional credit to close quickly. Documenting: FIN-7912 will track the customer credit. No recurring changes to commit profile without AM+Finance signoff.

devin_billing: Logged FIN-7912: provisional credit $1,850 pending INFRA-54444 backfill. Will hold final DB credit until infra backfill is complete.

maria_infra: I'll open infra ticket INFRA-54444 to fix proration race and run a backfill for 2026-04-05 window. Action items from infra:
- Patch proration job to coalesce temporary migration tags into parent account when a migration window is detected.
- Re-run allocation backfill for NH-77 covering 2026-04 period.
- Produce corrected invoice draft and place in S3 staging for finance review.

maria_infra: ETA for patch + backfill: 48 hours.

billing-bot: Auto-alert: `proration-race-detected` NH-77 2026-04-05T12:10Z. Candidate duplicate prorate line flagged.

devin_billing: Note: when issuing credit, include line item explanation: "Duplicate prorated reserved commit created during migration orchestration; corrected and refunded." Also include the goodwill concession note.

lucy_am: Draft customer note: "Thanks for raising this. We found a proration race during your migration that created an extra prorated reserved commit line. We've applied a provisional credit of $1,850 and will issue a corrected invoice after we backfill meter records. This is a one-time correction and won't change your committed profile going forward. ETA for finalized invoice: 48 business hours." Approving to send once FIN-7912 recorded.

raj_fin: Approved. Please route final credit for signoff after backfill to @raj_fin.

maria_infra: INFRA-54444 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-54444. Backfill scheduled tonight. I'll post completion timestamp in this thread.

devin_billing: I'll prepare a strike-through invoice and send provisional adjustment note to NovaraHealth. BCC legal for the corrected template.

lucy_am: Thanks team. Closing checklist: 1) INFRA-54444 created + PR for proration coalescing; 2) Backfill completes and generates corrected allocation; 3) FIN-7912 finalize credit and issue revised invoice; 4) Customer confirms receipt.

maria_infra: Backfill finished: 2026-04-06T05:12Z. Results: prorated line removed in regenerated allocations. Attaching S3 path for corrected invoice draft.

devin_billing: Verified backfill output; proceeding to finalize credit in FIN system and issue corrected invoice. Notifying customer now.

billing-bot: FIN action: credit_applied FIN-7912 amount=1850 recipient=NH-77 timestamp=2037660900

lucy_am: Customer confirmed receipt and accepts corrected invoice. Closing FIN-7912. :white_check_mark:
